worldcombat.skill.sketch.summary: Permanently replace Sketch’s slot with an opponent’s recent move. Known non-Pokémon attacks are translated into corresponding moves.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.use.0: Permanently learn one of a foe's moves
worldcombat.skill.sketch.use.1: Copy a rare set-up or recovery
worldcombat.skill.sketch.use.2: Put a heavy attack into your own move set
worldcombat.skill.sketch.description.0: Observe a target within %1$s blocks for %2$s. A Pokémon’s last move permanently replaces Sketch’s slot with full PP.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.description.1: The move requires a readable prior action. Sketch itself cannot be sketched from a Pokémon, and moves you already know are not learned again.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.preference.ai.m: Damaging moves below this power are not sketched (status moves are exempt). Sketch has one use, so raise it to save it for a real prize.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of drawing. Larger values sketch from further away.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.preference.ai.l: When on, the user may leave its post to sketch; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.sketch.world: A known native attack successfully used by a non-Pokémon in the last 60 seconds is translated into a move that permanently replaces Sketch: ordinary melee→Tackle, sting→Poison Sting, ram→Headbutt, mace→Slam, arrow→Fury Attack, trident→Horn Attack, fireball→Ember, sonic boom→Sonic Boom, indirect magic→Psybeam. Unlisted attacks cannot be sketched; you learn the corresponding move’s full action.
